description: Counts with many zeros, an exposure offset and integer prior weights.
generator_code:
{
    n <- 200L
    d <- data.frame(x0 = 1, x1 = rnorm(n), exposure = runif(n, 0.2, 1.5), w = sample(1:3, n, replace = TRUE))
    d$offset <- log(d$exposure)
    d$y <- rpois(n, d$exposure * exp(-1 + 0.5 * d$x1))
    d
}
